items.quote: The calorimetric investigations of U-(LBE) followed by XRD and SEM-EDS investigations of the mixtures helped in understanding their interaction behaviour.
The basic features of the high-temperature Calvet calorimeter, Setaram HT-1000, are given elsewhere [22].
The enthalpy of mixing of Bi-U liquid solution and the enthalpy of formation of Bi2U intermetallic compound were measured by direct reaction calorimetry.
